messages:
jordana (sales): Heads up — ACME just asked for a 10x uplift in embedding throughput next quarter. They want soft overage on month 1 while we ramp.
anya (pm): Do we have their current baseline numbers? is this for hosted or dedicated?
lucy (eng): They said hosted. Current peak for them is ~200 req/s embeddings, they want burstable to ~2k req/s for a 15m window. Batchable, but latency can't exceed 300ms p50.
omar (finance): 10x is expensive. If we do soft overage we need a formal credit mechanism or pre-purchased burst credits. Can't finance unlimited bursts.
mia (support): Also flagging operational risk — support load will spike on rollout. We need a runbook + auto-escalation to eng on quota hits.
kevin (legal): "soft overage" needs language: temporary grace is OK but cap liability. We should limit free overage to X credits or Y dollars and require signed addendum.
srini (product): Proposal: add "elastic burst" as a paid add-on in pricing for Q2. Behavior: per-tenant burst pool (short window), auto-throttle after pool drained, optional overage billing if they opt-in. Launch criteria: performance tests (+50% headroom), billing integration, usage dashboard, playbook, legal T&Cs.
anya (pm): Can we sketch the quota model? options: per-minute rate limit with burst tokens, or pre-bought burst credits that convert to overage price. Which is easiest to ship?
lucy (eng): Fastest is per-minute burst tokens backed by existing rate-limiter + cache heuristics. We need a new evict policy for KV cache when bursts happen. That is ~3 weeks dev + 1 week load testing.
omar (finance): Pricing suggestion: base embedding tier unchanged. Elastic-burst add-on: $X / 100k burst-tokens, overage price = 0.6 * on-demand until monthly cap. We should model three customer profiles before committing.
kevin (legal): Also need to add a maximum liability clause and implementation detail: bursts > 24 hours require contract amendment.
srini (product): Draft checklist for Q2 rollout: 1) perf tests (p99, p50), 2) billing flow end-to-end, 3) quota dashboard + alerts, 4) support playbook + runbook, 5) legal T&Cs + SOW template. Everyone OK with that scope?
jordana (sales): Sales asks for a trial period (14 days) of burst credits for key accounts and a quick SLA (response time) if we oversubscribe. Will trade for higher committed spend.
lucy (eng): Trial mode is fine if we enforce hard cap after trial credits. Implementation detail: trial credits are just prepaid burst tokens — no special infra.
release-bot: Scheduled release window for elastic-burst feature: 2026-05-10 02:00 UTC -> target ship in Q2. CI jobs: 14/14 passing for rate-limiter tests.
omar (finance): Can someone run a quick P&L on the proposed pricing? I need three scenarios: conservative, expected, aggressive.
anya (pm): I'll own the roadmap ticket and the launch PR. Action items: @lucy - engineering estimate + risk list by EOD Fri; @omar - pricing scenarios by Mon; @kevin - draft T&Cs snippet by Tue; @mia - support playbook skeleton by Tue; @jordana - list pilot accounts and committed spend targets.
jordana (sales): Pilot accounts: ACME, Betalo, Ingress Labs. I'll get verbal OKs this week.
srini (product): If we hit blockers on KV eviction or p99, fallback option: limited dedicated lanes for 1–2 enterprise customers (requires sales + infra). Not ideal but viable.
lucy (eng): Noted. I'll include cost of dedicated lane in risk doc.
anya (pm): OK — we're aligned. We'll revisit tradeoffs in roadmap sync next Tues. :thumbsup:
